title: Historical Violin Trade Datasets
description:
Historical Violin Trade Datasets gathers datasets on the historical trade in violins, built from primary sources: dealer and workshop ledgers, and published price catalogues.

Ledgers: the Lupot–Gand–Bernardel–Caressa–Français corpus at the Musée de la musique (Philharmonie de Paris), registers E.981.8.29 (purchase and resale, 1920–1944) and E.981.8.30 (export journal, 1926–1939), transcribed, normalised and cross-referenced.

Price catalogues: the American section of J. H. Fairfield, Known violin makers (1942; 4th ed. 1983), 171 makers coded by status and followed in the auction record to the present.
